Custom Heavy Duty On and Off-Road Touring Bicycles
Rodriguez UTB™ Image Gallery
Rodriguez UTB™
Originally custom designed in 1996 for Adventure Cyclist and columnist Willie Weir, the Rodriguez UTB™ has long set the standard for rugged, versatile, 'go anywhere' touring bikes. On or off road, this bike will get you where other bikes can't and it will do it with style and rider comfort!
• Tour Anywhere - On or Off Road!
• Built to ISO standards - Serviceable anywhere
• No limits - Choose your wheels (26" or 700c)
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• Triple chainrings offer a gear range over 600%
• Available in our Extreme Journey version
• Road proven model for over 20 years!
Full bike from $4,200

Yes! We ship bikes anywhere. How is the UTB™ different than the Rodriguez Adventure classic Touring bike?
Available in
Rohloff version
When we design a UTB™, we design it with the idea that the rider will probably carry more weight on the bicycle. So, a heavier gage down tube and chain stays are generally selected. We also build the UTB™ with a fork that we designed for our tandem bikes. This means when you've got 70 pounds or more of gear on your bike, it still rides smooth and stable.
Another difference is wheel clearance. For the UTB™, we build in more clearance for even wider tires than on the Adventure. This adds a bit of labor during the frame build, but for off road touring, you may need this extra room.
UTB Extreme Journey Design:
Choose the UTB™ Journey model for super frame strength. This model, introduced in 2014, is actually built using several of our Rodriguez tandem tubes for those traveling with extreme amounts of weight on the bike.
